Merch for the Rome’s Joy family

{{INTRO}}

Rules every idea follows
  • No President Obama name, image or quotes, and no Obama Foundation or Obama Presidential Center marks, on any product.
  • No musicians’ names, faces or song titles. The ballroom’s own history (“Est. 1940”) is fair to use.
  • No certification claims, such as Halal, on products until the company confirms them in writing.
  • Start small: print-on-demand, short runs or local makers, not warehouse stock.
